title: Waterfront access waiver for 63 Exterior Street, Bronx
summary: This application would let the developers space waterfront walkway access points more than 600 feet apart, easing a zoning rule for the Harlem River Waterfront District. It is meant to support construction of two new mixed-use buildings at 63 Exterior Street and 110 East 138th Street in the Bronx. The project is a joint effort by the city's Department of Housing Preservation and Development and East 138th Street JV Associates LLC.
